### Comment Spin Slot
![](../../../images/usage-1792771759702.webp)

- Randomly draws text or images and displays them slot-machine style.
- When you set the display width and height, the display is scaled up or down along the longer side.
- Press "Spin" or "Long-text Slot" to check how it works.
	- Images shown in the slot cannot be checked in the preview.
